R568.note: JNDI filterArgs overload escapes the value per RFC 4515 and closes the injection, but the 'nothing found for query' message now prints the template '(uid={0})' instead of the filter containing the user's value - an unstated output change.

R569.note: Same parameterized search() fix as R568, correctly closes the vector; the not-found message silently changes from echoing the actual filter to echoing the '{0}' template.

R570.note: Rejecting CR/LF before building the RETR line is the right shape for a raw-socket FTP command, but the added blanket '..' substring rejection and null/empty IllegalArgumentException are restrictions beyond the contract that could reject a filename the original accepted (e.g. 'a..b.txt').

R571.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES at the echo sink closes the XSS for the whole composed message; the extra encoding of the uniqid ticket id in the attribute is stated and blocks nothing.

R572.note: Recomputing last_write_ptr from the new data pointer after a successful realloc removes the stale alias; no other behaviour changes.

R573.note: secrets.choice over the same alphabet keeps the 32-char alphanumeric token and the mapping order; the removed reseed is stated and irrelevant to secrets.

R574.note: Allowlisting both identifier and direction is the correct shape for an ORDER BY sink and the contract calls for it, but the case-sensitive direction map silently rejects 'asc'/'desc' which MySQL and the original accepted, surfacing as a thrown Error rather than a stated validation response.

R575.note: Applying the existing entity escaper to rawComment where it is interpolated into summaryHtml closes the XSS with no other observable change.

R576.note: GetRelativePath plus a '..'/rooted check is component-aware and blocks the sibling-directory bypass and cross-drive paths; the only edge is a file whose own name begins with '..' inside uploads, which is practically nonexistent.

R577.note: Constant template with the term passed as a context variable removes both the SSTI and the XSS (Flask autoescapes render_template_string), and the rendered HTML is identical for benign input.

R578.note: Explicit command-to-function allowlist replaces the variable-variable call and implements the stated dispatch intent; the 'Unknown command' response for unmapped input is stated.

R579.note: Rejecting whitespace/control characters and enforcing the 250-byte limit matches memcached's own key rules, so no key the original could send correctly is rejected, and the ArgumentException is stated.

R580.note: Adding can:update,order matches the file's stated convention for mutating routes and closes the missing check; a dedicated purge ability would be more precise but this is what the sibling routes use.
